Names that are not QML dot paths: a protocol URL and a file name. The notes page's title contains a dot and a space, so the bare title is not a QML dot path; the page is linked by its title in braces:
- [https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/)
